create_scalar_graph: create a scalar graph with a given weight and calc_grad flag using gtn.scalar_graph
create_linear_graph: create a linear graph with M rows and N columns using gtn.linear_graph
test_scalar_graph_creation: test scalar graph creation by verifying num_arcs, num_nodes, and weights match expected values
test_linear_graph_creation: test linear graph creation by verifying node count, arc count, labels, and weights
set_graph_weights: set weights on a gtn graph using set_weights with a flat list of values
